candidates.title: PMKS: Co-Designing Distributed Networking and Multi-Tier Storage for Ultra-Long Context LLM Inference
candidates.reason: PMKS explicitly tiers KV state across GPU VRAM, host RAM, local NVMe SSD and RDMA-connected remote storage with asynchronous predictive prefetch, directly extending hierarchical-memory and storage-backed long-context inference lineages.

candidates.title: KV Cache Reuse for Elastic LLM Inference on Edge Devices
candidates.reason: ElastKV reuses mixed-precision KV caches by selectively recomputing high-impact entries, directly connecting elastic on-device inference, quantization and KV-cache reuse.

candidates.title: SIFT: Selective-Index For Fast Compute of RAG Prefill by Exploiting Attention Invariance
candidates.reason: SIFT replaces stored document KV tensors with compact attention-location indexes and sparse prefill computation, directly updating RAG prefill, KV reuse and storage-transfer bottleneck lineages.

candidates.title: HieraSparse: Hierarchical Semi-Structured Sparse KV Attention
candidates.reason: HieraSparse couples hierarchical KV pruning with semi-structured sparse GPU kernels across prefill and decode, directly extending sparse-attention and KV-cache compression lineages.

candidates.title: Efficient KV Cache Migration for Geo-Distributed LLM Inference in Collaborative Edge Computing
candidates.reason: EdgeFlow jointly uses direct KV transmission and activation-based recomputation to migrate state across heterogeneous geo-distributed edge servers, directly extending KV migration, disaggregated serving and edge-inference lineages.
